family_title_en: Complete the word with the correct diphthong: oi, oy, ou, ow

stages.ix_title: Complete the word with the correct diphthong: oi, oy, ou, ow

what_to_do.en: Tap oi, oy, ou, or ow.
what_to_do.ko: oi, oy, ou, ow 중에서 누르세요.

gold_items.stem: The h-se is big and red.
The red fl-er is in the yard.

roots: Choices are always oi, oy, ou, ow in that order. Exactly one choice is correct.
Hide the diphthong of one word with a hyphen. The hyphen stands for exactly those two letters.
The correct pair must build one real word. The other three pairs must not build a real word.
For the gaps b-, t-, c-, and h-, bow, tow, coy, and hoy are real words. The sentence must fit only boy, toy, cow, or how.
Do not print the finished word. No other stem word may contain the letter pairs oi, oy, ou, or ow.
On tiers 2 and 3 the tempting miss is the same-sound partner, oi or oy, and ou or ow.
Use oy at the end, oi before a consonant, ow at the end or before n, and ou in the middle. Flower keeps ow before er.
Keep sentences in school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No brands and no real names.
Every stem word except the hyphen token and NAME must come from the roots word list. Copy hyphen tokens from allowed_extra_words.

tier_rules.1: Four to six words. A common one-syllable word with the diphthong at the end, as in boy and now, or the pattern in coin. A wrong pair does not spell the word.
tier_rules.2: Five to seven words. One-syllable words where the same sound has two spellings. The near miss is oi against oy, or ou against ow, in the wrong part of the word.
tier_rules.3: Up to ten words. Two-syllable words such as flower and about, where ow before er or ou in the middle tempts the other spelling of the same sound.

oi_middle.en: Oi comes in the middle of a word, as in coin and point. Oy is for the end.
oi_middle.ko: oi는 coin, point처럼 단어 가운데에 옵니다. 끝에는 oy를 씁니다.

oy_final.en: Oy comes at the end of a word, as in boy and joy. Oi is for the middle.
oy_final.ko: oy는 boy, joy처럼 단어 끝에 옵니다. 가운데에는 oi를 씁니다.

ou_middle.en: Ou comes in the middle of a word, as in house and about. Do not use ow there.
ou_middle.ko: ou는 house, about처럼 단어 가운데에 옵니다. 그 자리에는 ow를 쓰지 않습니다.

ow_final.en: Ow comes at the end of a word, as in now and cow. Ou is not used at the end.
ow_final.ko: ow는 now, cow처럼 단어 끝에 옵니다. 끝에는 ou를 쓰지 않습니다.

ow_before_n.en: Use ow before n, as in down, town, and clown. Ou is not the spelling there.
ow_before_n.ko: down, town, clown처럼 n 앞에는 ow를 씁니다. ou로 쓰지 않습니다.

ow_before_er.en: Flower uses ow before er. Do not spell this word with ou.
ow_before_er.ko: flower는 er 앞에 ow를 씁니다. 이 단어는 ou로 쓰지 않습니다.
